title: A step can be put between two steps
why: Coach Milan 23 November 2026, 19:03, after making a recipe (Lazy Burek): a step can only be added at the end. He needed one between (spray the oil over the batter, sprinkle the sesame); Chef Mealan wrote oil for the tray instead. 20:23: B161 is the least relevant; steps and layers next (DT345 and B162). Drawn.

opportunity.from: Coach Milan's own recipe, Lazy Burek, 23 November 2026.
opportunity.job: Fix a recipe's steps in the order I cook them.
opportunity.kind: Missing: a step can only be added at the end; steps cannot be moved.
opportunity.why_now: Recipes are fixed right after the first cook, when a missing step shows.

story: When I edit a recipe's steps, I want to add a step between two steps, so that the steps stay in the order I cook.
proposed: 1. In Edit recipe, between two steps, a + Step here button. A tap puts an empty step there, the cursor in it; the steps after it move down one. 2. + Add a step at the end stays. 3. The same wherever the steps are written: Edit recipe, and the publish sheet. Enter at the end of a step already starts a new step after it; nothing changes there. Empty steps go on save, as now.
problem: Edit recipe has + Add a step at the end only, and steps cannot be moved. A step that belongs between two steps lands after the oven and the resting, so the recipe reads in the wrong order.
checks: Light: Edit recipe's steps and the publish sheet's steps. The unit tests; the build; a new walkthrough for AC1 to AC4; and recipe-after, recipe-photos and cook-mode, about 5 minutes. New words on screen, so the German sweep too.
decision: Asked 19:03; next 20:23. Drawn 23 November 2026 for Coach Milan's look. No Go, so nothing is built.
now: Lazy burek in Edit recipe: five steps and + Add a step at the end. The step for the oil and the sesame belongs between step 3 and step 4; added, it is step 6.
looked_at: Moving steps up and down: not chosen for now; inserting where the step belongs is the one move that was missing. Drag to reorder: harder on a phone and with the keyboard open.

ac.title: A step between two steps
ac.text: Given Edit recipe with five steps, when I tap + Step here between step 3 and step 4, then an empty step 4 is there with the cursor in it, and the steps that were 4 and 5 are 5 and 6

ac.title: Saved in its place
ac.text: Given the new step written, when I tap Save changes, then the recipe's steps read in that order, the new one fourth

ac.title: At the end, as before
ac.text: Given Edit recipe, when I tap + Add a step, then a step is added at the end, as now

ac.title: Left empty
ac.text: Given a step added between two and left empty, when I save, then it is gone and the steps keep their order

unchanged: Enter at the end of a step starts a new step after it.
A tap on a food puts it into the step where the cursor is.
A step's photo stays with its step.
details: Each + Step here is a button of at least 44 px, with its own label: Add a step between step 3 and step 4.
The pictures are the real app on one scratch build of main, not committed, with the clock on Monday 23 November 2026, 20:30.
short: + Step here between two steps in Edit recipe
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
